primary_source.title: Boğaziçi Üniversitesi Bilgi İşlem Daire Başkanlığı Faaliyet Raporu 2025
primary_source.section: BUCARD SİSTEMİ ÇALIŞMALARI / Yemekhane ve Paket Yemek Sistemleri Geliştirmeleri

public_facts.claim: A BUCard dining real-time report page existed in 2025 and packaged-meal counts were added to it.
Daily passage reports were updated to include packaged-meal information.
A breakfast field and related calculation changes were added to the personnel meal report.
A BUCard mobile application was deployed for dining halls and packaged-meal distribution points.
A mobile packaged-meal sales application was deployed across packaged-meal sales points and offline-sales capability work was performed.
The same BİD report describes institution-wide API documentation standardization (BUAPI) and integrated institutional-data initiatives (BUHUB).
public_facts.warning: This does not prove a dining-report API or BUHUB dining dataset exists.

acquisition_priority: blank/redacted report template or screenshot if releasable
export/API capability after semantics are understood
raw events only if aggregates cannot answer the decision and institutional approval supports it
minimum_questions: What physical/business event does each report count represent?
Which dimensions exist: date, campus/location, meal period, service channel, actor class?
Is the live report current-state only or historically retained?
How often does the live report refresh?
Can bounded reports be exported as CSV/Excel/API or generated by the owner?
How are package sales/entries distinguished from hall passage?
How are duplicates, corrections, refunds and offline package transactions handled?
Which institutional role currently consumes the report?
Does any operator change a quantity, batch, allocation or service mode based on it?

falsifiers: all production and dispatch are irreversible before live counts arrive
decision owner cannot see/use the report
report counts cannot be reconciled to remaining demand

privacy_architecture.preferred_grain: service-level aggregate; interval aggregate only if same-day decision is validated

claim_firewall: No team access to the BUCard reports is claimed.
No historical retention or export capability is claimed.
No passage count is equated with served, consumed, accepted or settled meals.
No same-day adaptive production capability is claimed.
No claim is made that Food Services, TEMAŞ or Control Organisation currently uses the real-time report operationally.
